territorial_scope.description: Applies to enterprises and designated bodies in Japan, administered by Japanese competent ministers.

evidence.quote: 我が国における特定高度情報通信技術活用システムの開発供給に関係する産業の国際競争力の強化

summary.short: Promotes development, supply and introduction of specified advanced ICT systems and production of specified semiconductors in Japan. The competent minister certifies enterprise plans; the Japan Finance Corporation, designated banks and NEDO support certified projects through loans, guarantees and subsidies. Enacted as Act No. 37 of 2020.
summary.long: Promotes the development, supply and introduction of specified advanced information and communication technology utilization systems, such as wireless and switching equipment and inspection drones used for national, local government and critical infrastructure work, and the construction and operation of production facilities for specified semiconductors. Article 3 sets basic principles and Article 6 requires competent ministers to issue guidelines. Enterprises may submit development, supply, introduction and semiconductor facility plans for certification (Arts. 7, 9, 11). Certified plans may be changed only with approval, and certification may be revoked or changes ordered for non-implementation or non-conformity (Arts. 8, 10, 12). Certified projects may obtain loans from the Japan Finance Corporation through designated financial institutions (Arts. 13-18), special rules for SME investment and credit insurance (Arts. 25-27), and NEDO grants and interest subsidies for semiconductor facilities (Art. 29). Designated institutions must keep books, report and accept supervision (Arts. 19-22). Violations of reporting, bookkeeping and inspection duties are punishable by fines of up to 300,000 yen (Art. 37). Certain officers of the Corporation face a non-penal fine of up to 1,000,000 yen for acting without required approval (Art. 38). A review clause calls for evaluation three years after enforcement.
